disposition.reason: This docket is an enforcement action the Town of Pittsford brought against Travis Bovey and Boondock Motors, not an appeal of a municipal decision; the permit at issue authorizes commercial hauling, towing and an autobody shop, not housing.

evidence.quote: This is an enforcement action brought by the Town of Pittsford (Town) against Travis Bovey and Boondock Motors (together, Respondents)
which authorized with conditions Respondents’ commercial hauling/trucking and towing services and operation of an autobody shop
This action follows an appeal of an April 1, 2022 notice of violation issued to Respondents by the Town

judgments.note: The only document is a post-judgment contempt decision in a town-initiated enforcement action over a commercial trucking/autobody permit; the NOV appeal it follows was a different docket (22-ENV-00062).
The court calls this docket an enforcement action brought by the Town; the earlier appeal of the notice of violation was docket 22-ENV-00062, not this one.
The permit covers commercial hauling/trucking, towing and an autobody shop; no housing is involved.

history.note: Excluded: town enforcement action over a commercial trucking/autobody permit.
